connector.name: Zotero Library MCP
connector.registryDescription: Add papers and books to Zotero by DOI, arXiv ID, or ISBN and manage your library
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package zotero-library-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the raulsimpetru account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ZOTERO_LIBRARY_ID
env.description: Your Zotero user or group library ID

env.name: ZOTERO_API_KEY
env.description: Zotero API key with read/write permissions

env.name: ZOTERO_WEBDAV_URL
env.description: WebDAV URL for file storage (if using WebDAV sync)
